answer: Every epoch, at a random second set by a public beacon, each registered agent gets its own memory-hard puzzle. It needs 4 GB of RAM for 20 seconds, and the seed is tied to its ID. All puzzles land at once and expire together, so a farm cannot run one box for many fakes or reuse an answer. A hundred fakes need a hundred machines sitting idle all epoch, waiting for that tide. An ID that misses gets no rewards that epoch. No whisper of the time leaks early, and renting a terrace of racks costs more with each fake.
